== Walkthrough ==

''Hail, Lorekeeper Brita''

Lorekeeper Brita says, 'Greetings to you. I see those who call themselves enchanters. Are you an enchanter?'

''I am an enchanter''

Lorekeeper Brita says' 'I thought so. I have several tasks for you accomplish. Once you have completed them I will have a cap, a robe, sleeves, wristbands, gloves, leggings and boots to reward you with.'

'''Gems are dropped in various Velious zones while Torn Enchanted Silk can be found on Veterans, Adjudants, and Legionnaires in Kael Drakkel. These high level giants can be found near King Tormax and near the Arena area.'''

'''After turn-in:'''

Lorekeeper Brita smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse.
* Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
</div>
{{YouGainExperience}}
